GenAiFunction.description: Renders a generic, caller-driven editable action grid. Pass a JSON `spec` describing the columns (key/label/type: readonly|text|select|switch, with options for selects) and the rows (an id plus a value per column key). The action flattens it into typed, data-bound cells the user reviews, adjusts, and confirms in the card; a Confirm gathers the whole revised grid as one payload. Call with no spec to show a portable demo triage plan.
